# Part 1: HRV Measurement Theory

## What is Heart Rate Variability?

Heart Rate Variability (HRV) quantifies the **beat-to-beat variability in cardiac rhythm**. Instead of a constant heartbeat, healthy hearts show natural variation in the time between consecutive beats.

**Why HRV matters:**
- Reflects autonomic nervous system balance (parasympathetic vs sympathetic)
- Indicator of cardiovascular health and fitness
- Marker of stress, fatigue, and recovery
- Clinical diagnostic tool for arrhythmias and neuropathy

## HRV Analysis Domains

```{julia}
println("HRV Feature Extraction (44+ features)")
println("=" ^ 60)

domains = Dict(
    "Time Domain" => ["mean", "sdnn", "rmssd", "pnn50"],
    "Frequency Domain" => ["vlf_power", "lf_power", "hf_power", "lf_hf_ratio"],
    "Nonlinear" => ["sd1", "sd2", "dfa_alpha1", "sample_entropy"],
    "Geometric" => ["triangular_index", "tinn"]
)

for (domain, features) in domains
    println("\n$domain:")
    println("  " * join(features, ", "))
end
```

## Load Test Data

```{julia}
# Generate synthetic IBI data
println("\nGenerating synthetic IBI data...")
ibi_data = 800 .+ 100 .* sin.(range(0, 4π, length=500)) .+
           randn(500) .* 30
ibi_data = max.(ibi_data, 300)

println("✓ Generated $(length(ibi_data)) IBI samples")
println("  Duration: $(round(sum(ibi_data)/60_000; digits=1)) minutes")
println("  Range: $(round(Int, minimum(ibi_data)))-$(round(Int, maximum(ibi_data))) ms")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(ibi_data); digits=1)) ms")
println("  Std Dev: $(round(std(ibi_data); digits=1)) ms")
```

---

# Part 2: IBI Visualization & Feature Analysis

## 4-Panel IBI Visualization

```{julia}
# Create comprehensive IBI visualization
fig = Figure(size=(1400, 900))

# Panel 1: Time Series
ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1], xlabel="Beat #", ylabel="IBI (ms)",
           title="Inter-Beat Interval Time Series")
lines!(ax1, 1:length(ibi_data), ibi_data, color=:steelblue, linewidth=1.5)
hlines!(ax1, mean(ibi_data), color=:coral, linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)
band!(ax1, 1:length(ibi_data),
      fill(mean(ibi_data) - std(ibi_data), length(ibi_data)),
      fill(mean(ibi_data) + std(ibi_data), length(ibi_data)),
      color=(:steelblue, 0.2))

# Panel 2: IBI Distribution (Histogram)
ax2 = Axis(fig[1, 2], xlabel="IBI (ms)", ylabel="Count",
           title="IBI Distribution")
hist!(ax2, ibi_data, bins=40, color=(:coral, 0.7), strokewidth=1)

# Panel 3: Poincaré Plot
ax3 = Axis(fig[2, 1], xlabel="IBIₙ (ms)", ylabel="IBIₙ₊₁ (ms)",
           title="Poincaré Plot", aspect=DataAspect())
scatter!(ax3, ibi_data[1:end-1], ibi_data[2:end],
         markersize=5, color=(:purple, 0.5))
lims = extrema([minimum(ibi_data), maximum(ibi_data)])
lines!(ax3, [lims[1], lims[2]], [lims[1], lims[2]],
       color=:gray, linestyle=:dash, linewidth=2)

# Panel 4: Cumulative Distribution
ax4 = Axis(fig[2, 2], xlabel="IBI (ms)", ylabel="Cumulative Probability",
           title="Empirical CDF")
sorted_ibis = sort(ibi_data)
ecdf_vals = (1:length(sorted_ibis)) ./ length(sorted_ibis)
lines!(ax4, sorted_ibis, ecdf_vals, color=:darkgreen, linewidth=2)

display(fig)
println("\n✓ 4-panel visualization created")
```

## Feature Extraction

```{julia}
# Extract all HRV features
println("\nExtracting HRV features...")
@time feature_df = HeartRateLab.extract_feature_set(ibi_data)

# Display key features
key_features = ["mean", "sdnn", "rmssd", "pnn50", "sd1", "sd2",
                "lf_power", "hf_power", "lf_hf_ratio"]

display_features = [f for f in key_features if f in names(feature_df)]
feature_subset = feature_df[!, display_features]

println("✓ Extracted $(length(names(feature_df))) total features")
println("\nKey Features:")
show(feature_subset; allrows=false)
```

# Part 3: Mechanistic Modeling

## Van der Pol Oscillator

```{julia}
println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
println("Model 1: Van der Pol Oscillator")
println("=" ^ 60)

# Create model instance
vdp = VanDerPol()

# Define parameters and generate synthetic IBIs
vdp_params = (μ=1.2, heart_rate=70.0)

println("\nGenerating synthetic IBIs from Van der Pol model...")
@time vdp_synthetic = simulate(vdp, vdp_params, 200)

println("✓ Generated $(length(vdp_synthetic)) IBIs")
println("  Mean: $(round(mean(vdp_synthetic); digits=1)) ms")
println("  Std: $(round(std(vdp_synthetic); digits=1)) ms")

# Compare features
synthetic_features = HeartRateLab.extract_feature_set(vdp_synthetic)
println("\nModel Validation (feature comparison):")
for feat in ["mean", "rmssd", "pnn50"]
    if feat in names(feature_df)
        real_val = feature_df[1, feat]
        synth_val = synthetic_features[1, feat]
        println("  $feat: real=$(round(real_val; digits=1)), synthetic=$(round(synth_val; digits=1))")
    end
end
```

## Model Comparison

```{julia}
println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
println("Available Models in HeartRateLab")
println("=" ^ 60)

models_info = """
1. **VanDerPol**: Deterministic harmonic oscillator with nonlinearity parameter
   - Mechanistic ODE-based model
   - Parameters: μ (nonlinearity), heart_rate

2. **Lorenz**: Chaotic attractor system
   - Exhibits complex nonlinear dynamics
   - Parameters: σ, ρ, β, threshold, noise

3. **LIF**: Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neuron
   - Stochastic model capturing threshold behavior
   - Parameters: τ_mem, threshold, reset, input_current, noise

4. **DMD**: Dynamic Mode Decomposition
   - Data-driven spectral decomposition
   - No parameters to fit (purely data-driven)
"""

println(models_info)
```

## Phase-Space Visualization

```{julia}
println("\nGenerating phase-space trajectories...")

# Generate trajectories for multiple parameter values
fig = Figure(size=(1200, 800))

param_values = [0.8, 1.2, 1.6]
colors = [:blue, :red, :green]

for (idx, μ) in enumerate(param_values)
    ax = Axis(fig[div(idx-1, 2)+1, mod(idx-1, 2)+1],
              xlabel="Position", ylabel="Velocity",
              title="Van der Pol Phase Space (μ=$μ)")

    # Generate synthetic data
    params = (μ=μ, heart_rate=70.0)
    synthetic = simulate(vdp, params, 300)

    # Compute IBI differences (velocity proxy)
    velocity = diff(synthetic)

    # Plot phase space
    scatterlines!(ax, synthetic[1:end-1], velocity,
                  color=colors[idx], markersize=4,
                  linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7)
end

display(fig)
println("✓ Phase-space visualization complete")
```

# Part 4: Summary & Insights

## Library Architecture

```{julia}
println("\n" * "=" ^ 60)
println("HeartRateLab.jl Architecture Overview")
println("=" ^ 60)

summary = """
**Core Capabilities:**
1. IBI Data Loading & Validation
   - Multiple format support (text, ECG)
   - Robust preprocessing and filtering

2. Feature Extraction (44 features)
   - Time-domain: statistical measures
   - Frequency-domain: spectral analysis
   - Nonlinear: entropy, DFA, geometric indices
   - Windowed: temporal dynamics

3. Mechanistic Models
   - ODE-based: Van der Pol, Lorenz
   - Stochastic: LIF neuron model
   - Data-driven: Dynamic Mode Decomposition
   - Unified interface: simulate() and fit()

4. Model Fitting & Validation
   - Bayesian inference: Turing.jl integration
   - Gradient-based: Optim.jl
   - Ensemble generation & validation
   - Statistical diagnostics

**Usage Pattern:**
  model = VanDerPol()
  params = (μ=1.2, heart_rate=70.0)
  synthetic = simulate(model, params, n_beats)
  features = extract_feature_set(synthetic)
"""

println(summary)
```
